rules.condition: Credible non-consensual recording, private-space surveillance, stalking/tracking, eavesdropping, or private/intimate-media sharing is present.
Consent, ownership, private location, provenance, relationship, or recording purpose is unresolved while privacy-risk conduct is present.
Explicit consent, owner authorization, disclosed security monitoring, or ordinary public context is established and no other violation is present.
Generic prevention, education, research, reporting, or fiction contains no live victim material or facilitation.
Identity, consent, age, ownership, and private location cannot be inferred from appearance or an LLM.
